title: Unsent prompt drafts and pending attachments do not survive a reload
outcome:
Prompt drafts live only in refs - draftsBySessionIdRef: Record<string, string> and draftAttachmentsBySessionIdRef in the live-state layer - and nothing writes them to browser storage (a localStorage search across ui/src finds workspace layout, control-panel section order and orchestrator template state, but no drafts). A refresh, a crash, or a closed tab therefore discards a half-typed prompt and any attached images with no warning and no recovery.

Found while designing the recovery for a failed lazy chunk load (see the chunk-recovery task): that design needs a reliable "is there anything to lose" predicate before it may reload automatically, and the workspace-layout pending marker does NOT cover drafts. So this gap is also a blocker for the automatic half of that recovery - not just a usability issue on its own.

Scope note: this is the plain user-facing loss. Whether drafts belong in the persisted workspace payload or in their own per-session storage entry is open; the workspace payload is PUT to the server and drafts are local-only, which argues for a separate key.
